why: Two files can both be correct and still not be comparable. Absent these declarations a reviewer compared the spend file against the vendor file and reported an inconsistency that did not exist. Cross-file arithmetic is blocked without a declared, overlapping population.

declarations.scope_statement: IT application and platform spend by category.
declarations.spend_perimeter: Software, platform, cloud and IT services. EXCLUDES internal labour, facilities, telecom and non-IT enterprise categories.
declarations.reason: The vendor file spans enterprise-wide third parties including ground handling and catering, which are outside this perimeter.

declarations.vendor_perimeter: All contracted suppliers including non-IT categories such as ground handling, catering and BPO.
declarations.amount_basis: contracted annual value, not in-year actual spend
declarations.reason: Wider population and a different basis (contracted value vs actual spend).
